title: Roadmap
summary: Build the app first (P0 to P5), then measure it fairly (P6 and P7), then write it up (P8).

stages.name: Build
stages.summary: A working, secure browser container that measures itself.

stages.name: Measure
stages.summary: Fair tests against Chrome and Edge, then smart tab sleeping.

stages.name: Publish
stages.summary: Statistics, figures and the research paper.

phases.name: Planning
phases.one_line_goal: Plan written, checked and approved by you; no app code yet

phases.name: Foundation
phases.one_line_goal: Tools confirmed, empty project builds, riskiest ideas tested

phases.name: First working app
phases.one_line_goal: One window browses websites safely: address bar, back, forward, refresh

phases.name: Tabs and sessions
phases.one_line_goal: Many tabs, restored after a restart, with separate data per site

phases.name: Security
phases.one_line_goal: Blocking, permissions and isolation proven by tests; threat model written

phases.name: Measurement
phases.one_line_goal: Memory, CPU, timing and network logged, and the numbers proven accurate

phases.name: Benchmarks
phases.one_line_goal: Fair, repeatable tests vs Chrome, Edge and plain Tauri; first data collected

phases.name: Smart tab sleeping
phases.one_line_goal: Four tab-sleeping strategies built safely and compared on the test bench

phases.name: Research paper
phases.one_line_goal: Results analysed; paper drafted with every claim checked

same_in_every_phase.title: One commit per task
same_in_every_phase.summary: Each finished, checked task is saved on its own, so an interruption loses at most one task.

same_in_every_phase.title: A plain-language log entry
same_in_every_phase.summary: After each task Claude writes what was done and what comes next, in plain words.

same_in_every_phase.title: The gate script must pass
same_in_every_phase.summary: One PowerShell script runs all of the phase's checks and saves the output as evidence. The phase cannot end until it passes.

same_in_every_phase.title: Your review at the end
same_in_every_phase.summary: Each phase ends with you reviewing the evidence and approving in Claude Code. Then Claude pauses: the next phase starts only when you explicitly say go.

same_in_every_phase.title: Portal and wiki in sync
same_in_every_phase.summary: Every wiki change carries its plain-language portal text in the same edit, so this portal is never out of date.
